findings.title: ORDERING 8.3 probe worksheet understates U9 pad 5 / 6 exposure beyond the body as 0.10 mm (board fab body and TI RPW0010A give 0.15 mm minimum, 0.20 mm nominal)
findings.contradicts: TI TPS25947 datasheet SLVSFC9C, RPW0010A package outline (p. 'PACKAGE OUTLINE', drawing 4225183/A): body 1.9-2.1 mm x 1.9-2.1 mm (2 mm x 2 mm nominal, device table p. 1), https://www.ti.com/lit/ds/symlink/tps25947.pdf; and the board's own U9 B.Fab body rectangle.
findings.evidence: docs/ORDERING.md line 552 (8.3 probe worksheet, 'U9 IN / OUT' row): "U9's pads 5 and 6 expose only 0.10 x 0.30 mm beyond the body at each end". Board a0ec075e (pcbnew): U9 at B(18.5,81.6), rot 0; pad 5 BAT_IN x 18.10-18.40, y 80.40-82.80; pad 6 RAW_PROTECTED x 18.60-18.90, y 80.40-82.80; B.Fab body rect x 17.45-19.55, y 80.55-82.65 (2.10 mm, line width 0.10 mm). Exposure per end = 80.55 - 80.40 = 0.15 mm (board body = datasheet maximum); 0.20 mm at the 2.0 mm nominal body and 0.25 mm at the 1.9 mm minimum. The 0.10 mm figure comes from round 23's reading of the fab line's outer edge (17.40-19.60, round23_docs_binding.md line 55), not the body edge; the same B.Fab rect (17.45-19.55) is on the round 18 board acba196 and round 24 board f2b8251, so it was never 2.2 mm. Probe script .supervisor/r33_docs_binding/u9.py, fab.py.
findings.impact: A procedure fact stated wrongly (the exposed probe land is 0.15-0.25 mm, not 0.10 mm). Conservative direction; the probe point B(18.25,80.45) still lies on exposed copper, so the step stays usable.
findings.concrete_fix: ORDERING 8.3 U9 row: "U9's pads 5 and 6 expose 0.15-0.25 mm (0.20 mm nominal; RPW0010A body 1.9-2.1 mm) x 0.30 mm beyond the body at each end". Optionally note pad 9's outer 0.15-0.25 mm (x 19.55-19.70 at the maximum body) is likewise exposed, while R84.1 stays the recommended ILM probe.

observations: ORDERING 8.3 'pad 9 itself is under the body': pad 9 (x 19.10-19.70) extends 0.15-0.25 mm beyond the body edge; the instruction (probe at R84.1 instead) is still right, so left as an observation and folded into the fix of -01.

R10_VALIDATION line 2771 (d') gives R173 at B(16.87,59.70); it sits inside the labelled 'After the fix pass (a3144b15...)' round 18 record, so it is history (R173 is B(16.87,59.05) since D-R26-02, as AVA_LAYOUT's round 26 table states).
The coordinate scan's other mismatches (TP82, R403, D440/D441, C87, C88, TP88, C10/C11/R164/R173 'from' positions) are all inside labelled move or round history entries.

The 5.71 V 'four-stall' point is the four-stall-plus-fire loaded pack (parts_budget pack_7V4_by_stall_count[4] 5.713 V); the four-stall without fire is 5.881 V; the records already define it as 'the fire budget's four-stall point, which already includes the 1.28 A fire current'.
J400 dry-contact current 'about 7 uA' = 8.4 V / 1.24 MOhm = 6.8 uA; D402 50 nA leakage shifts EN by 50 nA x (470k||770k) x 300/770 = 5.69 mV, matching '5.7 mV'.
Nominal turn-on 88 / 56 / 45 ms reproduces (tau 227.4 kOhm x 220 nF = 50.0 ms, 1.2 V threshold).
